notes.title: Farmer's Father Full Release!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Farmers
The day has finally come![/h3] 🏆

[previewyoutube=9bnxCvkLVss;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Today is the BIG DAY we've been waiting for! - full release of Farmer's Father: Save the Innocence[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42643366/44d6dc82dbeeabb49156228567c3e0b6fde08bb3.jpg[/img]

Thanks for your [b]support, reviews, and information you provided,[/b] we've made it to this very moment! ːsteamhappyː 🏆

[h3][b][u]To celebrate the premiere, we have uploaded a major update![/u][/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Added sawmill quest,
[*] Added treasure hunting quest,
[*] Fixed bug related to soldiers and NPCs,
[*] Fixed the notation of clouds (quest mark) and names above characters,
[*] Corrected errors with various quests after loading the game,
[*] Corrected errors with soldiers and their states after saving and loading the game,
[*] Improved running of NPC characters and no jams on objects,
[*] Optimization fixes,
[*] Corrections of translations into each language (punctuation, appropriate letters of the word), deletion of "Polish" and "English" words that were inserted into Chinese, Korean, Russian and Ukrainian translations,
[/list]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1905980/Farmers_Father_Save_the_Innocence/

You can get Farmer's Father with a 33% discount, but in a bundle for even less. Check just a few of our offers.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/31519/_Farmers_Life_and_Farmers_Father/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/31207/Farmers_Father_and_Aquarist/
